name: Jest of the Stinging Geyser
body:
School: enchantment (compulsion) [mind- affecting]; Level: jester 3

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: touch

Target: creature touched

Duration: 1 round per level

Saving Throw: Reflex negates; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Your attacks with any prop can score critical hits against the target on a roll of 18-20 for the duration of the spell. If you have ranks in the Perception skill, you gain a +2 bonus to your attack roll versus this target.
